types.title: Types of Crooked Teeth Treatments

items.title: 1. Traditional Metal Braces
items.description: Reliable and highly effective for correcting mild to severe alignment problems, with decades of proven results.

items.title: 2. Ceramic Braces
items.description: Designed to blend in with your natural teeth while delivering the same excellent orthodontic results as metal braces.

items.title: 3. Clear Aligners
items.description: Virtually invisible, removable aligners that gradually move teeth into place with greater comfort and convenience.

items.title: 4. Retainers
items.description: Worn after active treatment to maintain your new smile and prevent teeth from shifting back over time.

types.footer: Our team will assess your bite, alignment, and lifestyle to recommend the treatment option best suited to your goals.

items.question: How long does crooked teeth treatment take?
items.answer: Treatment duration varies depending on the severity of misalignment, but most orthodontic treatments take between 12 and 24 months.

items.question: Are braces painful?
items.answer: You may experience mild discomfort for a few days after braces are fitted or adjusted, but this usually subsides quickly.

items.question: Can adults get crooked teeth treatment?
items.answer: Yes. Orthodontic treatment is effective for both teenagers and adults, and many adults choose clear aligners for a more discreet option.

items.question: What are clear aligners?
items.answer: Clear aligners are transparent, removable trays that gradually straighten teeth without the appearance of traditional braces.

items.question: How much does crooked teeth treatment cost in Pune?
items.answer: The cost depends on the complexity of the case and the type of orthodontic treatment recommended. A consultation allows us to provide an accurate estimate.

items.question: Do I need retainers after treatment?
items.answer: Yes. Retainers help maintain the corrected alignment and prevent teeth from shifting over time.

items.question: How do I choose the best crooked teeth treatment near me?
items.answer: Look for a clinic with experienced orthodontic professionals, advanced technology, strong patient reviews, transparent pricing, and personalized treatment plans.
